full_prompt_en: The square image is a finely rendered, near-monochromatic painted portrait of a young woman wearing an elaborate embroidered headdress against a nearly black background. Her head and shoulders face mostly forward, with her face turned just slightly into a three-quarter angle and her eyes directed toward the viewer. A tall pale cap rises above her forehead, built from layered bands of lace, stitched motifs and small circular ornaments. Its crown has a gently irregular top edge, while a broader embroidered band crosses above the brows. Long narrow fabric panels descend along both sides of her face and continue over the shoulders. The material is pale grey and ivory, with fine floral embroidery, tiny bead-like details and faint raised seams visible across the cap and sleeves. A high collar wraps the neck, its close folds joining the head covering without exposing much skin below the jaw. The face is softly lit and carefully modelled, with softly warm pale cheeks, a straight nose, dark eyes and closed muted pink lips. A narrow shadow under the chin separates the head from the collar. Her shoulders fill the lower half in a light garment whose sleeves carry repeating stitched decoration and small gathered folds. The fabric on the right shoulder catches a faint highlight, while the far side sinks into grey shadow. The background is almost uniformly black, leaving a clean border around the pale silhouette; a few delicate threads or ties trail beside the head on the right. The image contains no readable text or clear setting. Frontal soft light reveals the embroidery without creating hard shadows, and subtle ivory, grey and beige value differences separate the fabric layers, with restrained natural warmth in the face. Fine embroidery follows the curved bands of the cap, with small circular motifs repeated across the forehead and crown. The long side pieces hang nearly straight before widening over the shoulders, where the garment shows delicate raised stitching. A few loose threads stand out against the dark background at the right edge. The eyes, nose and mouth remain sharply placed within the pale oval of the face, but the surrounding fabric is more intricately detailed than the expression. This quiet contrast gives the portrait a ceremonial, carefully arranged quality. The high collar closes neatly beneath the jaw and continues the pale vertical framing. Fine shadows beneath the embroidered bands preserve their layered construction. The overall composition is centred and nearly symmetrical, with the tall headdress and side panels framing the quiet face against a deep, uninterrupted ground.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形的精细刻画、近乎单色的绘画肖像：一位年轻女性戴着繁复刺绣高帽，身后是近乎黑色的背景。她以头肩像入画，整体朝向前方，脸略转成三分之四角度，目光望向观者。额头上方竖起一顶浅色高帽，由多层蕾丝、缝线纹样和小圆饰构成。帽冠顶缘略不规则，眉毛上方横过一条更宽的刺绣带。两条狭长布带沿脸颊两侧垂下，并延伸到肩部。布料呈浅灰与象牙白色，帽身和袖子上可见细密花卉刺绣、珠粒般小细节和淡淡凸起接缝。高领围住颈部，贴合的褶层与头饰相接，下颌以下几乎没有露出皮肤。面部受光柔和，刻画细致：带柔和暖色的浅色面颊、直鼻、深色眼睛和闭合的低饱和粉唇都清晰可见。下巴下方一道窄影将头部与衣领分开。浅色衣装的肩部占据下半部，袖子带有重复缝饰和细小聚褶。右肩布面接住一线微弱高光，远侧则沉入灰影。背景几乎通体纯黑，在浅色剪影周围留下清楚边界；头部右侧还有几根细线或系带垂落。画面没有可读文字或明确场景。正面柔光照出刺绣细节，却不形成硬影；象牙白、灰色与米色的细微明度差区分衣料层次，面部保留克制的自然暖色。细密刺绣沿着帽子的弧形分带延伸，额前与帽冠上重复出现小圆纹样。两条侧垂布片近乎笔直地落下，到了肩部才略微展开，衣料上能看到细致凸起的针脚。右侧边缘有几根松散线头从黑色背景中显现。眼睛、鼻子和嘴唇在浅色椭圆面孔上位置清楚，周围织物的装饰细节却比表情更繁复。这种安静对比令肖像显得庄重且经过精心安排。高领在下颌下方整齐合拢，并延续浅色的竖向框景。刺绣带下方的细影保留了层层叠合的结构。整体构图居中且近乎对称，高帽与侧垂带在深色、无间断底面前围住安静的面孔。
style_prompt_en: The finely rendered painting emphasizes intricate surface relief, layered texture and soft frontal illumination within a nearly monochromatic warm-neutral palette. Pale grey and ivory forms stand against a deep black ground, with tonal shifts separating delicate raised patterns from smoother areas. Edges remain controlled and clean, while small raised marks and repeated motifs provide intricacy. Shadows are gentle and limited, keeping the overall contrast elegant rather than severe. The composition favours central balance and vertical rhythm, with a calm, formal atmosphere and a carefully restrained range of values.
style_prompt_zh: 精细绘画表现以近乎单色的暖中性色调，强调繁密的表面浮凸、层叠肌理和柔和正面照明。浅灰与象牙白形体立于深黑底色之前，细微明度变化将凸起纹样与较平滑区域区分开来。边缘受控清晰，小型凸起痕迹和重复纹样带来繁复度。阴影柔和且范围有限，使整体反差优雅而不过分强烈。构图偏好中央平衡与竖向节奏，气氛安静正式，灰阶范围克制。
theme_en: Young woman in an ivory embroidered headdress against a dark ground
theme_zh: 深色背景前戴象牙白刺绣头饰的年轻女子
name: Eve Ventrue
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
